The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case No.: DR-2021-11, MUP-2021-06, MUP-2021-07, and MV-2021-2021-01 Location: 800 N. Azusa Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8608-025-906, -907, -908, -910, -914
Applicant: Serrano Development Group
The City of Azusa received a request for a Design Review request for a modification to previous approval of DR-2018-15 which includes changes to the exterior architectural style and minor site improvements. Minor Use Permit request for two (2) live/work units. Minor Use Permit request for tandem parking. Minor Variance for the reduction of the tandem parking stall. Updates to the previously approved Tentative Tract Map. The property is located in the Gold Line District within the Azusa TOD Specific Plan.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 32 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15332), (California Environmental Quality Act).
